mn85:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Bhaggesu viharati Suṃsumāragire Bhesakaḷāvane migadāye.
mn85:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena Bodhissa rājakumārassa Kokanado nāma pāsādo acirakārito hoti anajjhāvuttho samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā kenaci vā manussabhūtena.
mn85:3.1: Atha kho Bodhi rājakumāro Sañjikāputtaṃ māṇavaṃ āmantesi:
mn85:3.2: Ehi tvam, samma Sañjikāputta, yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkama; upasaṃkamitvā mama vacanena Bhagavato pāde sirasā vanda, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ puccha:
mn85:3.3: Bodhi, bhante, rājakumāro Bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchatīti;
mn85:3.5: Adhivāsetu kira, bhante, Bhagavā Bodhissa rājakumārassa svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti.
mn85:4.1: Evaṃ bho ti kho Sañjikāputto māṇavo Bodhissa rājakumārassa paṭisutvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami; upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi,
mn85:4.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Sañjikāputto māṇavo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca: --
mn85:4.3: Bodhi, bho Gotama, rājakumāro bhoto Gotamassa pāde sirasā vandati, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchati,
mn85:4.5: Adhivāsetu kira bhavaṃ Gotamo Bodhissa rājakumārassa svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenāti.
mn85:4.7: Atha kho Sañjikāputto māṇavo Bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā yena Bodhi rājakumāro ten' upasaṃkami; upasaṃkamitvā Bodhiṃ rājakumāraṃ etad avoca:
mn85:4.8: Avocumhā kho mayaṃ bhoto vacanena taṃ bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ:
mn85:4.9: Bodhi, bho Gotama, rājakumāro bhoto Gotamassa pāde sirasā vandati, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchati,
mn85:4.11: Adhivāsetu kira bhavaṃ Gotamo Bodhissa rājakumārassa svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenāti.
mn85:5.1: Atha kho Bodhi rājakumāro tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā Kokanadañ ca pāsādaṃ odātehi dussehi santharāpetvā yāva pacchimasopānakaḷevarā Sañjikāputtaṃ mānavaṃ āmantesi:
mn85:5.2: Ehi tvaṃ, samma Sañjikāputta, yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkama upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavato kālaṃ ārocehi --
mn85:5.4: Evaṃ bho ti kho Sañjikāputto māṇavo Bodhissa rājakumārassa paṭisutvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami; upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavato kālaṃ ārocesi --
mn85:5.5: Kālo, bho Gotama, niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan ti.
mn85:6.1: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena Bodhissa rājakumārassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami.
mn85:7.1: Tena kho pana samayena Bodhi rājakumāro bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhito hoti Bhagavantaṃ āgamayamāno.
mn85:7.2: Addasā kho Bodhi rājakumāro Bhagavantaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ;
mn85:7.3: disvāna paccuggantvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā purakkhitvā yena Kokanado pāsādo ten' upasaṃkami.
mn85:7.4: Atha kho Bhagavā pacchimaṃ sopānakaḷevaraṃ nissāya aṭṭhāsi.
mn85:7.5: Atha kho Bodhi rājakumāro Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:--
mn85:7.6: Abhirūhatu, bhante, Bhagavā dussāni; abhirūhatu Sugato dussāni,
mn85:7.7: yaṃ mama assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
mn85:7.10: kho Bodhi rājakumāro Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
mn85:7.11: Abhirūhatu, bhante, Bhagavā dussāni; abhirūhatu Sugato dussāni,
mn85:7.12: yaṃ mama assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti. Dutiyam pi kho Bhagavā tuṇhī ahosi. Tatiyam pi kho Bodhi rājakumāro Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca: Abhirūhatu . . . sukhāyāti.
mn85:7.13: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ apalokesi.
mn85:7.14: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando Bodhiṃ rājakumāraṃ etad avoca:
mn85:8.1: Atha kho Bodhi rājakumāro dussāni saṃharāpetvā upari Kokanade pāsāde āsanāni paññāpesi.
mn85:8.2: Atha kho Bhagavā Kokanadaṃ pāsādaṃ abhirūhitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghena.
mn85:9.1: Atha kho Bodhi rājakumāro Buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
mn85:9.2: Atha kho Bodhi rājakumāro Bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn85:9.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Bodhi rājakumāro Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:--
mn85:9.5: Na kho sukhena sukhaṃ adhigantabbaṃ, dukkhena kho sukhaṃ adhigantabban ti.
mn85:10.1: Mayham pi kho, rājakumāra, pubbe va sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa Bodhisattass' eva sato etad ahosi:--
mn85:10.2: Na kho sukhena sukhaṃ adhigantabbaṃ, dukkhena kho sukhaṃ adhigantabban ti.
mn85:11.1: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumara, aparena samayena daharo va samāno susu kāḷakeso
mn85:11.3: from Vol. I p. 163 1.28 to p.167 1.8; for
mn85:42.2: from Vol. I p.240 1.30 to p.249 1.21; for Aggivesana substitute rājakumāra) . . . ātāpino pahitattassa viharati.
mn85:54.1: Atha kho, rājakumāra, pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū mayā evaṃ ovadiyamānā evaṃ anusāsiyamānā na cirass' eva yass' aṭṭhāya kulaputtā sammad eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tad anuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihariṃsūti.
mn85:55.1: Evaṃ vutte Bodhi rājakumāro Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
mn85:55.2: Kīvacirena nu kho, bhante, bhikkhu Tathāgataṃ vināyakaṃ labhamāno yass' aṭṭhāya kulaputtā . . . vihareyyāti?
mn85:55.3: Tena hi, rājakumāra, taṃ yev' ettha paṭipucchissāmi. Yathā te khameyya tathā taṃ vyākareyyāsi.
mn85:55.5: Kusalo tvaṃ hatthārūyhe aṅkusagayhe sippe ti?
mn85:55.6: Evaṃ, bhante, kusalo ahaṃ haṭṭhārūyhe aṅkusagayhe sippe ti.
mn85:56.3: Bodhi rājakumāro hatthārūyhaṃ aṅkusagayhaṃ sippaṃ jānāti;
mn85:56.4: tassāhaṃ santike hatthārūyhaṃ aṅkusagayhaṃ sippaṃ sikkhissāmīti.
mn85:56.6: yāvatakaṃ saddhena pattabbaṃ, taṃ na sampāpuṇeyya.
mn85:56.8: yāvatakaṃ appābādhena pattabbaṃ, taṃ na sampāpuṇeyya.
mn85:56.10: yāvatakaṃ asaṭhena amāyāvinā pattabbaṃ, taṃ na sampāpuṇeyya.
mn85:56.12: yāvatakaṃ āraddhaviriyena pattabbaṃ, taṃ na sampāpuṇeyya.
mn85:56.14: yāvatakaṃ paññāvatā pattabbaṃ, taṃ na sampāpuṇeyya.
mn85:56.16: Api nu so puriso tava santike hatthārūyhaṃ aṅkusagayhaṃ sippaṃ sikkheyyāti?
mn85:56.17: Ekamekena pi, bhante, aṅgena samannāgato so puriso na mama santike hatthārūyhaṃ aṅkusagayhaṃ sippaṃ sikkheyya. Ko pana vādo pañcah' aṅgehīti?
mn85:57.3: Bodhi rājakumāro hatthārūyhaṃ aṅkusagayhaṃ sippaṃ jānāti;
mn85:57.4: tassāhaṃ santike hatthārūyhaṃ aṅkusagayhaṃ sippaṃ sikkhissāmīti.
mn85:57.10: yāvatakaṃ asaṭhena amāyāvinā pattabbaṃ, taṃ sampāpuṇeyya.
mn85:57.16: Api nu so puriso tava santike hatthārūyhaṃ aṅkusagayhaṃ sippaṃ sikkheyyāti?
mn85:57.17: Ekamekena pi. bhante, aṅgena samannāgato so puriso mama santike hatthārūyhaṃ aṅkusagayhaṃ sippaṃ sikkheyya. Ko pana vādo pañcah' aṅgehīti?
mn85:58.1: Evam eva kho, rājakumāra, pañc' imāni padhāniyaṅgāni.
mn85:58.3: Idha, rājakumāra, bhikkhu saddho hoti saddahati Tathāgatassa bodhiṃ:
mn85:58.4: Iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā ti.
mn85:58.5: Appābādho hoti appātiṅko samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato nātisītāya nāccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhānakkhamāya.
mn85:58.6: Asaṭho hoti amāyāvī yathābhūtaṃ attānaṃ āvikatvā satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu.
mn85:58.7: Āraddhaviriyo viharati, akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhūro kusalesu dhammesu.
mn85:58.8: Paññāvā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
mn85:59.1: Imehi kho, rājakumāra, pañcahi padhāniyaṅgehi samannāgato bhikkhu Tathāgataṃ vināyakaṃ labhamāno
mn85:59.2: yass' atthāya kulaputtā sammad eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tad anuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya satta vassāni.
mn85:59.38: Imehi pañcahi padhāniyaṅgehi samannāgato bhikkhu Tathāgataṃ vināyakaṃ labhamāno sāyam anusiṭṭho pāto visesaṃ adhigamissati, pātam anusiṭṭho sāyaṃ visesaṃ adhigamissatīti.
mn85:60.1: Evam vutte Bodhi rājakumāro Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
mn85:60.2: Aho Buddho, aho dhammo, aho dhammassa svākkhātatā;
mn85:60.3: yatra hi nāma sāyam anusiṭṭho pāto visesam adhigamissati, pātam anusiṭṭho sāyaṃ visesaṃ adhigamissatīti.
mn85:61.1: Evaṃ vutte Sañjikāputto māṇavo Bodhi-rājakumaraṃ etad avoca:
mn85:61.3: Aho Buddho aho dhammo aho dhammassa svākkhātatā ti vadeti,
mn85:61.4: atha ca pana na: taṃ bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṃghañ cāti.
mn85:61.5: Mā hevaṃ, samma Sañjikāputta, avaca; mā hevaṃ, samma Sañjikāputta, avaca.
mn85:61.6: Sammukhā me taṃ, samma Sañjikāputta, ayyāya sutaṃ sammukhā paṭigahītaṃ.
mn85:61.7: Ekamidaṃ, samma Sañjikāputta, samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme.
mn85:61.8: Atha kho me ayyā kucchivatī yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho me ayyā Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
mn85:61.9: Yo me ayaṃ, bhante, kucchigato kumārako vā kumārikā vā, so Bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchati dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṃghañ ca;
mn85:61.10: upāsakan taṃ Bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti.
mn85:61.11: Ekamidaṃ, samma Sañjikāputta, samayaṃ Bhagavā idh' eva Bhaggesu viharati Suṃsumāragire Bhesakaḷāvane migadāye.
mn85:61.12: Atha kho maṃ dhātī aṅkena vāhitvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho mama dhātī Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
mn85:61.13: Ayaṃ, bhante, Bodhi rājakumāro Bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchati dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṃghañ ca,
mn85:61.14: upāsakaṃ taṃ Bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan ti.
mn85:61.15: Esāhaṃ, samma Sañjikāputta, tatiyam pi Bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhusaṃghañ ca,
mn85:61.16: upāsakam maṃ Bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan
